prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 个人所得税专项附加扣除标准简表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "扣除项目" spans 1 col × 2 row; "每月标准（元）" spans 2 col × 1 row; "适用条件" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "扣除项目" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 133px
  col 2: header "每月标准（元） › 一般地区" · longest unbreakable word 37px · one-line width 203px
  col 3: header "每月标准（元） › 特殊情形" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 435px
  col 4: header "适用条件" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 1038px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 440px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 439px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"概览个人所得税专项附加扣除项目、每月标准及适用条件，帮助读者查找相关扣除。","reading":"先按首列找到扣除项目，再横向比较一般地区与特殊情形的标准，并阅读适用条件；每行应保持清晰的整体。","groups":["第二、三列同属每月标准，应便于并排比较；第三列的特殊情形说明也与第四列的适用条件相互关联。"],"keep_intact":["扣除金额及其单位","项目名称中的关键短语","一般地区和特殊情形的列标题"],"may_wrap":["较长的扣除项目名称可按自然词组换行","金额后的地区或家庭情形说明","适用条件中的完整句子；同一行其他单元格可利用该行已有高度换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [100, 81, 105, 153] · table 440×1314px · row heights [36, 60, 176, 176, 222, 222, 199, 222] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [85, 85, 85, 184] · table 440×1128px · row heights [36, 36, 199, 153, 176, 176, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [82, 81, 136, 140] · table 440×1454px · row heights [36, 60, 199, 199, 246, 246, 222, 246] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"项目名称较易识别，特殊情形列能容纳部分金额及说明；各行边界清楚。","problems":"一般地区标题换行，地区说明被切成很多短行；适用条件密集而狭窄，拉高多数数据行。","cause":"一般地区仅81px，扣除内边距后不足以容纳标题；适用条件仅153px，而项目列100px相对宽裕。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"表头完整，适用条件较易连续阅读；整体高度较低，行与行之间的节奏较均衡。","problems":"特殊情形中的金额和说明挤成窄列，首行尤其高；部分项目名称及一般地区说明也显得零碎。","cause":"特殊情形列仅85px，长说明频繁换行；首列85px对较长项目名称也偏紧。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"特殊情形列较宽，金额和说明更容易连读，与一般地区的比较有一定空间。","problems":"项目名称和表头断行过多，适用条件形成很窄的文字带，使多数行过高，留下大片空白。","cause":"特殊情形列占136px，挤压了首列82px、一般地区81px和适用条件140px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-conditions","widths":[88,85,91,175],"change":"以r0B为基础，略加宽项目和特殊情形列，从适用条件列借出少量空间，改善名称和特殊说明的换行，同时保留条件列的阅读宽度。"},{"name":"conditions-first","widths":[85,85,78,191],"change":"进一步加宽承载最长句子的适用条件列，观察缩窄特殊情形列后，首行高度与其余各行的阅读节奏能否取得更好平衡。"},{"name":"special-case","widths":[85,85,100,169],"change":"向特殊情形列多分配空间，让金额和说明形成较完整的词组；条件列仍比r0A宽，以检验两类长内容之间的折中。"}]}
